functionalRequirement: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must successfully save 100% of valid form submissions to the database with all fields correctly mapped to database columns.
identifiedNFRs.justification: This ensures the core functionality of saving information to the database works correctly as specified in the FR.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must appear within 300 milliseconds after the user clicks the submit button, regardless of database save operation completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick feedback is essential for good user experience when submitting forms, even if the background database operation is still in progress.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must complete the database save operation within 2 seconds for 95% of submissions under normal load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires saving information to the database, which needs to be performed efficiently to maintain system responsiveness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must clearly indicate the success status of the form submission using both color coding (green for success) and an appropriate icon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear visual feedback helps users understand that their form submission was successful.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must include a dismissible action (such as an 'OK' button or 'X' icon) that is at least 44x44 pixels in size for touch accessibility.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need a clear way to acknowledge and dismiss the confirmation, with sufficient target size for all input methods.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: If the database save operation fails, the system must retry the operation up to 3 times with a 2-second interval between attempts before showing an error message.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires saving to the database, and retry mechanisms improve reliability when temporary issues occur.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All form data must be validated on both client and server sides before being saved to the database, with input sanitization to prevent SQL injection attacks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Security validation is necessary when saving user-provided information to a database to prevent data breaches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup component must be implemented as a reusable module that can be configured with different messages, icons, and action buttons.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A modular approach allows for easier maintenance and consistency across the application when confirmation popups are needed.

functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must present all five support options (search, chat, community, email, call) with 100% availability whenever the support interface is accessed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that users should be able to choose from all these options, requiring complete functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load all support options within 1 second of the user navigating to the support page under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick loading of support options is necessary for users seeking assistance, especially in potentially urgent situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Each support option must be represented with a distinctive icon and clear descriptive text that communicates its purpose and expected response time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear visual and textual differentiation helps users select the most appropriate support channel for their needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The support options must be arranged in order of expected resolution time, from fastest (search) to slowest (email), to help users make informed choices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Logical organization of options based on resolution time helps users select the most appropriate support method for their urgency level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display accurate availability status for each support option (e.g., chat hours, current wait times) that updates at least every 5 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need reliable information about support availability to make appropriate choices about which channel to use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: When transitioning to any support option, the system must only pass the minimum required user information needed for that specific support channel.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Limiting data sharing between system components maintains user privacy while still enabling effective support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All support options must function correctly across desktop and mobile browsers, with the call option utilizing the device's native calling capabilities when available.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Support options need to work across different platforms to ensure all users can access help regardless of their device.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow administrators to enable, disable, or modify any of the five support options without requiring code changes or system restarts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Support channels may need to be adjusted based on staffing, business hours, or other operational factors.
